claims.evidence: Origin of use cannot be determined from visual inspection of the lens body.
Front glass is shown, but internal optics, rear glass, and mechanical components are not visible.

risks.risk: Internal fungus, haze, or heavy dust
risks.proof: A video of a flashlight or phone torch shining through the lens from one side to the other.
risks.if_unproven: as having optical defects requiring professional cleaning

risks.risk: Scratched or damaged rear glass element
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the rear glass element.
A video showing the lens successfully autofocusing on a camera body.
risks.if_unproven: as a manual-focus only lens with a broken motor

risks.risk: Damaged lens mount or electronic contacts
risks.proof: A photo of the metal mount and the gold-plated contact pins.
A video of a hand rotating the focus ring through its full range.

proof_requests: Photo of the rear glass element and the lens mount.
Video of a light shining through the glass to check for fungus/haze.
Video demonstrating the autofocus and manual focus ring movement.
response.reason: The witness has clearly identified the specific model, allowing for a worst-case valuation despite the lack of internal and rear condition reports.
